summary.en: Switch between heliocentric and geocentric frames as Earth overtakes Mars.
summary.zh: 在地心与日心参考系间切换，观察地球超越火星时的视运动。

boundary.en: The paths use approximate planetary elements. The loop is a coordinate effect; this view does not model topocentric observing conditions or atmospheric refraction.
boundary.zh: 轨迹使用行星近似根数。回环是坐标效应；本视图不模拟地表观测位置或大气折射。

prompt.en: Open the Sun-centered scene and compare the directions of Earth and Mars over the same interval.
prompt.zh: 打开日心场景，在同一时间段比较地球与火星的运动方向。

body.en: Both planets continue prograde around the Sun. Mars never reverses its heliocentric velocity during the apparent retrograde loop.
body.zh: 两颗行星始终沿同一公转方向绕太阳运行；视逆行期间，火星的日心速度从未反向。

prompt.en: Notice which planet covers more orbital longitude during the trajectory window.
prompt.zh: 观察在轨迹时间窗内，哪颗行星扫过的轨道经度更多。

body.en: Earth has the shorter period and gains longitude on Mars. Near opposition, Earth passes between the Sun and Mars.
body.zh: 地球周期更短，会逐渐追上火星；冲日前后，地球从太阳与火星之间超过火星。

prompt.en: Switch to the Earth-centered frame and look for the temporary loop in Mars’s path.
prompt.zh: 切换到地心参考系，寻找火星轨迹中的短暂回环。

body.en: Subtracting Earth’s motion from both bodies changes the apparent path. The loop appears because the observer is moving on the faster inner orbit.
body.zh: 从所有位置中减去地球运动会改变视轨迹；观测者位于更快的内侧轨道上，因此出现回环。

prompt.en: Compare the heliocentric and geocentric scenes without changing the date.
prompt.zh: 保持日期不变，对比日心与地心场景。

body.en: A reference frame changes coordinates, not the physical event. Retrograde motion is an apparent angular reversal on the observer’s sky.
body.zh: 参考系改变的是坐标而非物理事件；逆行是观测者天空中的视角方向反转。

title.zh: 同一太阳系，多种参考系

summary.en: Compare Sun-, Earth-, and Jupiter-centered descriptions of the same instant.
summary.zh: 对比同一时刻在日心、地心与木星中心坐标中的描述。

boundary.en: These are translated coordinate frames, not rotating dynamical frames. Fictitious forces are not integrated or displayed.
boundary.zh: 这些视图是平移后的坐标系，而非旋转动力学系；不会积分或显示惯性力。

prompt.en: Start with the Sun at the origin and identify the large-scale orbital ordering.
prompt.zh: 先把太阳放在原点，辨认太阳系的大尺度轨道次序。

body.en: The heliocentric frame makes the broad architecture compact: nested planetary orbits surround the dominant mass.
body.zh: 日心参考系让整体结构最清晰：行星轨道围绕占主导质量的太阳层层嵌套。

prompt.en: Look for loops and cusps that were absent from the Sun-centered tracks.
prompt.zh: 寻找日心轨迹中没有的回环与尖点。

body.en: The same positions become observer-relative tracks when Earth’s position is subtracted. Inner and outer planets acquire different apparent patterns.
body.zh: 减去地球位置后，同一组位置成为相对观测轨迹；内行星与外行星呈现不同视运动。

prompt.en: Change the origin again and compare the scale of Jupiter’s motion with the inner planets.
prompt.zh: 再次改变原点，比较木星与内行星相对运动的尺度。

body.en: A body-centered view is useful for local geometry, but it does not imply that every visible object is gravitationally bound to the reference body.
body.zh: 天体中心视图适合观察局部几何，但并不意味着画面中的每个对象都受该参考天体束缚。

prompt.en: Return to the Sun while keeping the same instant and selected bodies.
prompt.zh: 保持时刻和天体集合不变，再回到日心系。

body.en: Distances between bodies are invariant under this translation even though every plotted path changes shape.
body.zh: 平移参考系会改变每条绘制轨迹的形状，但天体之间的距离保持不变。

title.zh: 木星刻出的柯克伍德空隙

summary.en: Read resonances as missing density in semi-major-axis space.
summary.zh: 在半长轴分布中，把平均运动共振读成密度缺口。

boundary.en: The atlas displays the observed MPCORB distribution and resonance locations. Its two-body propagation does not dynamically excavate the gaps.
boundary.zh: 图谱展示观测到的 MPCORB 分布与共振位置；二体传播本身不会动态形成这些空隙。

prompt.en: Open a–e element space and scan the main-belt density from 2 to 3.5 AU.
prompt.zh: 打开 a–e 元素空间，观察 2–3.5 AU 的主带密度。

body.en: The belt is structured. Narrow low-density bands interrupt the otherwise dense population.
body.zh: 主带具有明显结构；在高密度分布中，若干狭窄低密度带贯穿其中。

prompt.en: Compare the vertical resonance guides near 2.50 and 2.82 AU with the point density.
prompt.zh: 把 2.50 与 2.82 AU 附近的竖直共振标线同点密度比较。

body.en: These labels mean an asteroid completes roughly three or five revolutions while Jupiter completes one or two. Repeated perturbations destabilize parts of phase space.
body.zh: 这些比例表示小行星与木星在相同时间内完成近似整数圈数；重复摄动会使部分相空间失稳。

prompt.en: Widen the interval and compare the gaps near 2.96 and 3.28 AU across inclination.
prompt.zh: 扩大范围，在不同倾角上比较 2.96 与 3.28 AU 附近的缺口。

body.en: The gaps persist across much of the plotted inclination range, showing that semi-major-axis resonance—not display color—is organizing the structure.
body.zh: 缺口跨越较大的倾角范围，说明组织结构的是半长轴共振，而不是显示颜色。

title.en: Distribution is evidence, not an integration
title.zh: 分布是证据，不是积分结果

prompt.en: Ask what this plot directly shows and what requires an N-body model.
prompt.zh: 区分这张图直接显示的证据，以及必须依靠 N-body 模型回答的问题。

body.en: MPCORB supplies today’s osculating population. Explaining long-term depletion rates requires perturbation theory or numerical N-body integrations beyond this fast atlas mode.
body.zh: MPCORB 提供当前密切轨道总体；解释长期清空速率需要摄动理论或数值 N-body 积分，超出快速图谱模式。

title.en: Why Trojans gather at L4 and L5
title.zh: 特洛伊群为何聚集在 L4/L5

summary.en: Explore the rotating geometry around Jupiter’s stable triangular points.
summary.zh: 探索木星轨道上稳定三角拉格朗日点周围的旋转几何。

boundary.en: L4/L5 markers use instantaneous circular restricted three-body geometry. The atlas does not integrate Trojan libration or long-term stability.
boundary.zh: L4/L5 标记使用瞬时圆型限制性三体几何；图谱不会积分特洛伊天体的天平动或长期稳定性。

prompt.en: Turn on Lagrange markers and locate the points 60° ahead of and behind Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 打开拉格朗日点图层，定位木星前后各 60° 的位置。

body.en: In the circular restricted three-body model, L4 and L5 form equilateral configurations with the Sun and Jupiter.
body.zh: 在圆型限制性三体模型中，L4、L5 与太阳、木星构成等边三角形。

prompt.en: Open the catalog with the Jupiter Trojan class and compare its orbital scale with Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 在目录中打开木星特洛伊分类，并把轨道尺度同木星比较。

body.en: Jupiter Trojans have periods near Jupiter’s, so their mean longitudes remain near the two 1:1 resonance islands rather than spreading uniformly.
body.zh: 木星特洛伊天体的周期接近木星，因此平均经度停留在两个 1:1 共振岛附近，而非均匀铺开。

prompt.en: Move several years forward and see the L4/L5 markers rotate with Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 向前移动数年，观察 L4/L5 标记随木星一起转动。

body.en: The markers are recomputed from Jupiter’s instantaneous Sun-centered position. They show the rotating geometry, not individual Trojan integrations.
body.zh: 标记根据木星瞬时日心位置重新计算；它们展示旋转几何，而不是单个特洛伊天体的积分轨迹。

prompt.en: Decide whether a static L4 marker alone proves that a real asteroid is stable.
prompt.zh: 判断一个静态 L4 标记能否单独证明真实小行星长期稳定。

body.en: It cannot. Stability depends on libration amplitude, eccentricity, inclination, planetary perturbations, and long integrations. This scene is a geometric teaching layer.
body.zh: 不能。稳定性取决于天平动幅度、离心率、倾角、行星摄动与长期积分；本场景只是几何教学层。

summary.en: Atira, Aten, Apollo, and Amor are geometric orbit classes, not risk scores.
summary.zh: 阿提拉、阿登、阿波罗与阿莫尔是几何轨道分类，并非风险等级。

boundary.en: Orbit class is determined from osculating geometry. It does not encode impact probability, future close approaches, or observational uncertainty.
boundary.zh: 轨道分类来自密切几何，不包含撞击概率、未来近距离接近或观测不确定度。

prompt.en: Filter the catalog to all near-Earth classes and inspect q, a, and Q rather than the object’s current distance.
prompt.zh: 筛选全部近地分类，观察 q、a、Q，而不是天体当前距离。

body.en: NEO classes describe the shape and scale of an osculating orbit relative to Earth’s orbit. A member need not be near Earth today.
body.zh: NEO 分类描述密切轨道相对地球轨道的形状与尺度；成员今天未必靠近地球。

prompt.en: Compare orbits whose aphelion stays inside Earth’s orbit with those whose semi-major axis is below 1 AU but cross it.
prompt.zh: 比较远日点始终在地球轨道内的轨道，以及半长轴小于 1 AU 但会穿越地球轨道的轨道。

body.en: Atiras remain interior by aphelion; Atens have a < 1 AU but can extend beyond Earth’s perihelion. The inequalities use orbital elements, not hazard estimates.
body.zh: 阿提拉的远日点位于地球轨道内；阿登的 a < 1 AU，但可延伸到地球近日点之外。这些不等式不是风险估计。

prompt.en: Switch between Apollo and Amor and watch how Earth-crossing versus Earth-approaching geometry changes.
prompt.zh: 在阿波罗与阿莫尔之间切换，观察穿越地球轨道与接近地球轨道的几何差别。

body.en: Apollos have a > 1 AU and perihelia inside Earth’s aphelion; Amors approach from outside but keep perihelia beyond Earth’s aphelion boundary.
body.zh: 阿波罗的 a > 1 AU 且近日点进入地球远日点以内；阿莫尔从外侧接近，但近日点仍在地球远日点边界之外。

prompt.en: Ask which additional evidence would be needed to estimate an impact probability.
prompt.zh: 思考估算撞击概率还需要哪些额外证据。

body.en: Risk work requires covariance, future perturbations, observation updates, and dedicated monitoring. Solar Atlas does not provide collision warnings.
body.zh: 风险分析需要协方差、未来摄动、观测更新与专门监测；Solar Atlas 不提供碰撞预警。

title.zh: 保护冥王星的 3:2 共振

summary.en: Pluto crosses Neptune’s orbital radius without close encounters.
summary.zh: 冥王星虽穿过海王星的轨道半径，却通过共振避免近距离相遇。

boundary.en: The plotted two-body ellipses show orbit crossing and approximate timing. They do not prove long-term resonant-angle libration under Neptune’s perturbations.
boundary.zh: 绘制的二体椭圆展示轨道相交与近似节奏，但不能证明海王星摄动下共振角的长期天平动。

title.zh: 轨道相交就一定会相遇吗？

prompt.en: Display Neptune and Pluto in 3D and compare their orbital radii and planes.
prompt.zh: 在三维中显示海王星与冥王星，比较轨道半径和轨道面。

body.en: No. Orbit curves can cross in projection while bodies arrive at the crossing region at different times and heights.
body.zh: 不一定。轨道曲线可在投影中相交，但天体可能在不同时间、不同高度到达交叉区域。

prompt.en: Compare the long trajectory windows: Neptune completes about three revolutions while Pluto completes two.
prompt.zh: 比较长时间轨迹：海王星约完成三圈时，冥王星约完成两圈。

body.en: Their mean motions are close to a 3:2 ratio. Resonant timing constrains the longitudes at which conjunctions recur.
body.zh: 二者平均运动接近 3:2；共振节奏限制了会合重复出现的经度。

prompt.en: Return to 3D and rotate until Pluto’s inclination relative to Neptune’s plane is visible.
prompt.zh: 回到三维并旋转视图，直到冥王星相对海王星轨道面的倾角清晰可见。

body.en: Inclination adds spatial separation near some projected crossings. Timing and three-dimensional geometry both matter.
body.zh: 在部分投影交点附近，倾角会增加空间分离；节奏与三维几何同样重要。

title.zh: 怎样才能证明保护机制？

prompt.en: Separate the visible period ratio from the uncomputed resonant angle.
prompt.zh: 区分画面可见的周期比与尚未计算的共振角。

body.en: A dynamical proof follows a resonant angle such as 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ over long N-body integrations. This atlas currently presents a geometric and kinematic explanation only.
body.zh: 动力学证明需要在长期 N-body 积分中跟踪 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ 等共振角；本图谱目前只提供几何与运动学说明。

title.en: The road out: Voyager and beyond
title.zh: 离开太阳系：旅行者号之路

summary.en: Separate real mission milestones from a schematic trajectory overlay.
summary.zh: 区分真实任务里程碑与示意轨迹叠加。

boundary.en: Spacecraft tracks interpolate dated mission milestones for teaching. They are not Horizons ephemerides, reconstructed gravity assists, or operational positions.
boundary.zh: 航天器轨迹为教学而插值带日期的任务里程碑，不是 Horizons 星历、重建的引力助推或业务位置。

title.zh: 为什么在 20 世纪 70 年代末发射？

prompt.en: Open the 1977 outer-planet scene and inspect the ordering of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
prompt.zh: 打开 1977 年外行星场景，观察木星、土星、天王星与海王星的排列。

body.en: A rare geometry enabled a chain of encounters, letting one planet redirect the spacecraft toward the next.
body.zh: 罕见的行星几何使连续相遇成为可能，让一颗行星把航天器偏转向下一颗。

prompt.en: Follow the schematic Voyager overlays through their dated giant-planet milestones.
prompt.zh: 沿着旅行者号示意叠加轨迹，追踪带日期的巨行星里程碑。

body.en: A gravity assist changes heliocentric velocity because the spacecraft exchanges momentum with a moving planet during the flyby.
body.zh: 引力助推会改变日心速度，因为航天器在飞掠移动行星时交换动量。

prompt.en: Change the date between milestones and notice the smooth teaching interpolation.
prompt.zh: 把日期移到里程碑之间，观察平滑的教学插值。

body.en: The curve communicates mission sequence and scale. It does not reproduce the reconstructed state vector between encounters.
body.zh: 曲线用于表达任务顺序与尺度，不会重现相遇之间的重建状态向量。

title.zh: 从行星巡游到星际任务

prompt.en: Compare the bounded planetary model with the outward spacecraft teaching path.
prompt.zh: 比较有界的行星模型与向外延伸的航天器教学路径。

body.en: For current spacecraft distance, direction, or navigation, use the mission team and JPL Horizons. Solar Atlas preserves the conceptual story and explicit provenance boundary.
body.zh: 当前航天器距离、方向或导航应使用任务团队与 JPL Horizons 数据；Solar Atlas 只保留概念故事并明确来源边界。
